title: Replace global settings with dependency injection
prompt:
notifier relies on a global mutable SETTINGS dict and module-level `global _transport` variables. Refactor to explicit dependency injection:
- notifier/config.py: a @dataclass Settings with fields sender='noreply@example.com', sms_prefix='+1', dry_run=False, max_retries=2.
- notifier/mailer.py: class Mailer(settings, transport) with method send_email(to, subject, body).
- notifier/sms.py: class SmsSender(settings, transport) with method send_sms(number, text).
- notifier/dispatcher.py: class Dispatcher(mailer, sms) with method notify(user, message).
Keep the current behavior (retries, dry-run, sms prefix, 160-char limit, return values). Delete notifier/settings.py and remove every `global` statement. Update the tests to the new API and run them.
